The lint rule doesn't run on internal library code, but it does look at the *exported* library types, since it can be used to help detect invalid library usage. These connector types get exported in the public API so they end up affecting the lint errors.

> If it makes sense to enforce a specific style, we should enable [https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/blob/main/packages/eslint-plugin/docs/rules/method-signature-style.md](https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/blob/main/packages/eslint-plugin/docs/rules/method-signature-style.md?rgh-link-date=2022-05-30T08%3A52%3A35Z)

That's a good idea. One downside is that it looks like the InstantSearch.js library *does* rely on `this` in certain places, so there are some function types where the non-arrow function might be more accurate. It doesn't change the runtime behavior though, so it's probably not a big deal.
